settings.html_codes: PACKAGE DESCRIPTION  Run The Seas is considering a seven-night cruise package for two adults. The experience could include a timed half marathon, timed 5K, 1K Family Fun Walk/Run, race bibs and RFID timing, exclusive medals and Captain’s Challenge recognition, official race merchandise, an awards celebration, presentations, cheer-zone seating, a free 12-week live online group coaching program, hydration and race support, and activities for Voyage Partners and families. Race and cruise photography may be available for purchase. One complimentary photo may be included. Private one-on-one coaching may be available for an additional fee. Taxes, port fees, gratuities and transportation to the departure port may be additional.
